name: Rabbrute
look: a titanic gorilla-like rabbit monster of many fused Hopples: dark grey fur dotted with little red eyes, a pale belly, a small eared head between huge shoulders, and white bunny-tuft forearms and shins
entry: The family form of Hopple. When a den is threatened, its Hopples pile into one another and fuse into a titan as tall as a mountain; every white tuft on it is a little face, and every red speck an eye watching over the family.
how: Hopple's family form: with three or more Hopples in your party, use Call of the Den from the interaction wheel of a Hopple that knows it (CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.10.0+). All the party's Hopples fuse into one Rabbrute, permanently.
It isn't found in the wild.
